findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key as a query parameter ?api_key=...
findings.actual: Query parameter api_key is rejected; requests require the X-API-Key HTTP header.
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/listings?api_key=... and received 401; request succeeded when using X-API-Key header.
findings.impact: Any client implemented directly from the documentation fails authentication completely.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} returns a single listing object.
findings.actual: Singular path returns 404 Not Found. The active backend endpoint is pluralized: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}.
findings.impact: Listing detail pages fail to resolve if using the documented singular path.

findings.documented: GET, POST, and DELETE /v1/favourites manage user saved listings.
findings.actual: All documented /v1/favourites routes return 404 Not Found.
findings.how_found: Probed /v1/favourites with valid bearer token after logging in.
findings.impact: Saved listing actions fail if sent to the documented route.

findings.documented: Endpoint is not listed anywhere in the API reference document.
findings.actual: Backend responds to GET and POST requests at /v1/saved to manage saved user listings.
findings.how_found: Tested fallback paths and verified state persistence at /v1/saved.
findings.impact: Developers following only documentation miss the working user-favourites backend.

findings.documented: Returns pre-computed city aggregates for a dashboard screen.
findings.how_found: Called documented path with API key and Bearer auth token.
findings.impact: Analytics must be calculated dynamically from raw collections.

findings.documented: Returns up to ten comparable listings at GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar.
findings.how_found: Tested endpoint with valid listing IDs.
findings.impact: Similar listing recommendations must be derived client-side.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: Returns inactive listings with is_live=false as well.
findings.how_found: Paged through all listings and checked the is_live flag values.
findings.impact: UI displays inactive/withdrawn inventory unless filtered client-side.

findings.documented: Listing records describe real, physically possible properties.
findings.actual: The dataset contains 18 listing records with invalid or internally inconsistent property data.
findings.how_found: Applied objective data-consistency checks: negative price/area/floor values, carpet area greater than super built-up area, and floor greater than total floors.
findings.impact: These records can distort property-level and market-level calculations and should be excluded from downstream analysis.

findings.actual: Four listings are extreme tiny-area/high-price outliers consistent with enquiry-generation fake listings: 100-6000578, 100-6000678, 100-6001599, MAG-6002941, SQU-6000395.
findings.how_found: Calculated price per square foot as price divided by carpet area for listings with valid positive price and carpet area. Listings with price per sqft <= ₹100  were flagged as extreme outliers.
findings.impact: Extreme price-per-square-foot outliers can significantly distort market-price calculations, so these listings are excluded from the downstream 2 BHK average price-per-sqft calculation.

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
findings.actual: 288 projects report a total_listings count that disagrees with the listing records carrying that project_id.
findings.how_found: Grouped all retrievable listing records by project_id and compared those counts against total_listings for each project.
findings.impact: Project cards relying on total_listings can show inaccurate unit counts.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in integer rupees.
findings.actual: Project price values are stored as mixed Crore/Lakh values rather than normalized integer INR. Values such as 1.66 represent Crores while values such as 94.6 represent Lakhs.
findings.how_found: Inspected project price_min and price_max values and compared them against listing prices and the documented INR unit. The raw project values contain decimal Crore/Lakh-scale values rather than integer rupee amounts.
findings.impact: Displaying raw values as INR produces property prices wrong by orders of magnitude.
